requirements.note: R1: help guidance points to sdd-forge docs build

requirements.desc: `sdd-forge check freshness` text output for both `stale` and `never-built` results must display `sdd-forge docs build` and must not display `sdd-forge build`.

requirements.desc: The fix must preserve freshness result classification, JSON output shape, and exit codes for `fresh`, `stale`, and `never-built`.
requirements.note: R3: JSON output shape and exit code contract stay unchanged

requirements.desc: `sdd-forge check freshness` must keep the existing user-facing argument contract: `--format <text|json>` accepts only `text` or `json`, `-h` and `--help` print help, and no internal-only arguments are introduced.
requirements.note: R4: format validation and help arguments keep the existing contract
